title: the_locker
beats: My high school had a locker that nobody used. Not broken. Not reserved. Just... skipped.
Number two-seventeen. The office assigned lockers around it every single year.
I didn't believe the rumors until sophomore year, when I got assigned that exact locker.
The first week? Nothing. I actually bragged about it. Called the whole story fake.
Folded squares of paper, inside my locked locker. Notes I never wrote. In handwriting that almost looked like mine.
The first one said: stop slamming the door.
The second one said: you're louder than the last one.
I stopped telling my friends, because they laughed. But I started photographing every note.
And here's what the photos showed that my eyes didn't. The handwriting was getting closer to mine. Letter by letter. Note by note.
The last one was perfect. Identical to my own handwriting.
I did not check the vents. I never opened that locker again.
I graduated two years later. On the last day, the cleaning crew found forty-one folded notes inside locker two-seventeen.
